description: A sandy beach on a bright day. A young woman lifeguard in a yellow jacket and red swimsuit kneels in the sand and presses down again and again with both hands on the chest of a grey training dummy, practising heart massage, sand flying up. A young man lifeguard in red shorts kneels beside her and counts with his hands raised. Another lifeguard in a red swimsuit jogs out of the waves towards them, past a lifeguard tower, rescue boards and colourful umbrellas.

taps.phrase: to jog across the wet sand
